description: Rothco’s Pocket Knife Multi Tool is a versatile, compact solution for all your outdoor and everyday tasks. Featuring high-quality stainless steel components, this multi tool comes with a durable plastic handle for a comfortable grip. The tool includes a 3 inch half-serrated blade, perfect for cutting through tough materials, along with needle nose pliers and regular pliers for grabbing and manipulating objects. It also offers wire cutters, a Phillips and flathead screwdriver, a bottle opener, and a can opener, making it an essential companion for any situation. The multi tool comes with a rugged polyester sheath, complete with a belt loop and snap closure for secure, hands-free carrying. Whether you're camping, working around the house, or out on an adventure, this tool is designed to provide reliable performance and excellent value.
